title: POMA: Beyond Final Flags -- Process-Level Evaluation of Base LLMs in Vulnerability Exploitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from text generation to autonomous software-engineering execution, automated vulnerability exploitability verification has emerged as a vital frontier in software quality assurance and security validation. Existing security benchmarks, however, largely judge models by binary pass/fail outcomes or coarse stage milestones. Such outcome-centric scoring obscures fine-grained failure dynamics across long-horizon execution and conflates the intrinsic capability of a base LLM with external agent scaffolding. We present POMA (Pwn-Oriented Model Assessment), a process-level evaluation methodology and platform that isolates base LLMs under a unified execution baseline -- fixing task inputs, tool interfaces, target environments, feedback formats, and execution budgets -- while measuring intermediate states and transitions from runtime evidence. Evaluating four frontier base LLMs across 55 CTF Pwn challenges

translated_title: POMA：超越最终Flag——漏洞利用任务中基础大语言模型的过程级评估
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）从文本生成演进为自主软件工程执行，自动化漏洞可利用性验证已成为软件质量保障与安全验证领域的重要前沿。然而，现有安全基准大多以二元的通过/失败结果或粗糙的阶段里程碑来评判模型。这种以结果为中心的评分方式掩盖了长程执行过程中细粒度的失败动态，并将基础LLM的固有能力与外部智能体脚手架的作用混为一谈。我们提出了POMA（Pwn-Oriented Model Assessment，面向Pwn的模型评估），这是一种过程级评估方法与平台，它在统一的执行基线下对基础LLM进行隔离评估——固定任务输入、工具接口、目标环境、反馈格式和执行预算——同时从运行时证据中测量中间状态与状态转换。该方法在55个CTF Pwn挑战题上对四个前沿基础LLM进行了评估……
tldr: POMA提出了一种过程级评估方法与平台，通过统一执行基线（固定任务输入、工具接口、目标环境、反馈格式与执行预算）隔离评估基础LLM，并在55个CTF Pwn挑战上基于运行时证据测量中间状态与状态转换，从而超越以最终成败Flag为中心的传统评测方式。
en_tdlr: POMA introduces a process-level evaluation methodology and platform that isolates base LLMs under a unified execution baseline—fixing task inputs, tool interfaces, environments, feedback formats, and execution budgets—while measuring intermediate states and transitions from runtime evidence across 55 CTF Pwn challenges, going beyond final-flag, outcome-centric scoring.
